run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-15T06:34:06Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The RequestErrorRate alert on otel-demo/frontend is explained by a misconfigured shipping deployment. At 06:32:46Z the shipping Deployment was rolled out (new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8, old shipping-75d58f5d84 scaled to 0, same image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping) with env QUOTE_ADDR changed from 'http://quote:8080' to 'quote:0000'. From then on every shipping /get-quote request fails: shipping's outbound span 'POST ' ends in 9-10 microseconds with otel.status_description 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' and the server span /get-quote returns 'Internal Server Error'. The failure is local URI parsing, so no request reaches quote (quote spans fall to 0 from 06:38:06 and quote's last log line is 06:32:50Z 'Calculated quote'). checkout PlaceOrder fails with gRPC status 13 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', frontend POST /api/checkout returns 500, and frontend's checkout-path error spans (2.385/s at 06:40Z) drive the alert. Quote itself shows a ready pod with 0 restarts, no new ReplicaSet and no error logs; cart, currency and product-catalog returned no error status and completed successfully inside the failing trace.

claims.text: At 06:40Z frontend had a STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate of 2.385/s alongside 40.63/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET spans, so frontend was emitting error spans at the time of the alert.

Frontend's error spans are confined to the checkout path: at 06:40Z 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder', 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' and 'POST /api/checkout' each showed 0.596/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR with 0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, while GET, GET /, GET /api/cart, POST /api/cart, GET /api/data, product and recommendation routes showed error rate 0.

The frontend error-rate series was 0 until the 06:35:06 evaluation point, then rose through 06:37:06 (1.81/s) to about 2.1-2.35/s from 06:39 to 06:45 and eased to 0.62/s at 06:47:06; checkout and shipping error rates follow the same shape and start at the same point.

At 06:40Z the only services with non-zero STATUS_CODE_ERROR span rate were frontend (2.385/s), frontend-proxy (1.226/s), checkout (1.215/s) and shipping (1.207/s); cart, fraud-detection, accounting, ad, payment and recommendation were at 0.

Shipping's own spans fail on quote retrieval: at 06:40Z '/get-quote' had 0.604/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET and outbound span 'POST ' had 0.604/s STATUS_CODE_ERROR; at 06:45Z the same pair was 0.530/s with '/get-quote' STATUS_CODE_UNSET still 0 and '/ship-order' 0, i.e. no successful quote call in those 5-minute windows.

Trace 3767891927621b4297f49efad5961ac3 shows the exact diagnostic: shipping span 'POST ' (span_id 2270e9b9b67fb68c, 10us) carries otel.status_description 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' as a child of shipping '/get-quote' (span_id b17707ff4e92c009, 64us) carrying 'Internal Server Error'; the failure propagates as checkout 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' gRPC status 13 with 'shipping quote failure: failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500', frontend 'POST /api/checkout' http.status_code 500, frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' http.status_code 500, and load-generator 'POST' http.status_code 500.

The same invalid-URI error appears on every shipping failure in the sampled set read from the kept result: 5 '/get-quote' ERROR spans each paired with a 'POST ' span whose otel.status_description is exactly 'Http(http::Error(InvalidUri(InvalidFormat)))' at durations of 9-10us, observed between 06:43:21 and 06:43:26Z (that kept result is truncated, so the whole 113-span set was not read).

The shipping Deployment template now sets container env QUOTE_ADDR to 'quote:0000' (image ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo:2.1.3-shipping, SHIPPING_PORT 8080), while the superseded ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84 (replicas 0) carries the same image with QUOTE_ADDR 'http://quote:8080'; the only template difference visible is that env value.

The quote Service exposes port 8080 with targetPort 8080 and selector opentelemetry.io/name=quote, and the quote container declares QUOTE_PORT 8080 and containerPort 8080, so 'quote:0000' does not name a port the quote service listens on.

Shipping was rolled out by its own controller at 06:32:46-06:32:53Z: events 'Scaled up replica set shipping-5ffdc77bc8 from 0 to 1', 'SuccessfulCreate pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn', 'Created'/'Started container shipping', 'Scaled down replica set shipping-75d58f5d84 from 1 to 0', 'Killing' and 'SuccessfulDelete pod shipping-75d58f5d84-gw77q'; the Deployment shows observedGeneration 2 with new ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 (created 06:32:46Z, ready 1) and old shipping-75d58f5d84 at 0 replicas.

The new shipping pod shipping-5ffdc77bc8-755zn started 06:32:46Z with the shipping container ready and 0 restarts; its logs show startup lines at 06:32:54Z ('Shipping service is running', 'starting service: "actix-web-service-0.0.0.0:8080"') followed only by repeated 'Requesting quote' lines, with no error text written by the application (that log read was limit-capped to the newest lines of a larger set).

Quote stopped receiving requests after the shipping rollout: quote's span rate for 'POST /getquote', 'calculate-quote' and '{closure}' fell from ~0.48-0.63/s at 06:33-06:34 to 0.16/s at 06:36:06, 0.06/s at 06:37:06 and 0 for every point from 06:38:06 through 06:48:06; at 06:40Z quote's STATUS_CODE_UNSET span rate was 0.

Quote itself shows no failure: quote-6b5877698d-6spfl is Running and ready with 0 restarts (started 05:56:15Z), the quote Deployment has a single ReplicaSet quote-6b5877698d created 05:56:15Z, and quote's container log contains only 'Calculated quote' lines, the newest at 06:32:50Z within the read slice.

Other checkout dependencies were not returning errors in the window: at 06:40Z cart had 13.33/s spans with 0 error rate, product-catalog 9.59/s STATUS_CODE_UNSET, currency 1.11/s STATUS_CODE_OK, payment 0 error and 0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET; in trace 3767891927621b4297f49efad5961ac3 checkout's CartService/GetCart, ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and CurrencyService/Convert calls completed with rpc.grpc.status_code 0 (currency server span otel.status_code OK) and prepareOrderItemsAndShippingQuoteFromCart failed at the shipping quote step.

Root cause hypothesis: the shipping rollout at 06:32:46Z introduced QUOTE_ADDR='quote:0000', which the shipping HTTP client cannot parse as a URI (InvalidUri(InvalidFormat), failing in 9-10us without any network call), so /get-quote always returns 500; checkout PlaceOrder therefore fails, frontend /api/checkout returns 500 and frontend's error spans drive the RequestErrorRate alert.

Rejected: the quote service itself being down or failing. Quote's pod is Running and ready with 0 restarts, its Deployment has no new ReplicaSet, its logs show no errors, and the failing shipping span ends in 10us with a URI-parse error, which occurs before any connection to quote; quote's span silence follows from shipping never sending the request.

Rejected: an email-service failure, suggested by the wrapped message 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500'. No email span appears in the failing trace and email's span rate at 06:40Z was 0 in both status dimensions; the only outbound span shipping produced in that trace is 'POST ' failing with InvalidUri(InvalidFormat) in 10us, and the shipping container template carries no email address variable.

Rejected: the shipping pod being damaged by crash, OOM or eviction. Its container is ready with restartCount 0 and no lastState, its events are only Scheduled/Pulled/Created/Started plus the controller's SuccessfulCreate and SuccessfulDelete of the new and old pods, and the Deployment's Progressing condition reports ReplicaSet shipping-5ffdc77bc8 successfully progressed at 06:32:53Z - a controller-driven rollout.

Recommendation emits a small, unrelated error signal: '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' shows STATUS_CODE_ERROR rates of 0.0037-0.0044/s at scattered points both before the incident (06:09:06, 06:11:06) and during it (06:35:06, 06:39:06, 06:43:06), with 0 at many points in between; it does not follow the checkout/shipping failure step and is not part of this error path.

Restore the shipping Deployment env var QUOTE_ADDR to 'http://quote:8080' (the value visible on ReplicaSet shipping-75d58f5d84) and roll the deployment, then confirm shipping /get-quote succeeds and quote receives traffic again.
Add validation in the config/chart or pipeline so an unparsable or non-existent quote address such as 'quote:0000' is rejected before rollout, and review the process that produced it for shipping.

gaps: The alerting rule RequestErrorRate and the listing of all alert rules both returned no data (status no_data) from list_prometheus_rules, so the alert's exact query, threshold and evaluation window could not be verified.
change_history is not an integrated source in this Run, so who or what applied the shipping QUOTE_ADDR change at 06:32:46Z, and whether it was intentional, cannot be established.

The shipping container logs contain only 'Requesting quote' lines and no failure text, so the error text is known only from span tags and the wrapped checkout exception; the shipping log read was limit-capped to the newest lines.

The kept shipping error-trace result (evidence dd7e0beb-6158-494c-90dd-1207ac251a2b-t0:4115f4a7-2b7e-4548-86bd-2d6be94ad5c4) is truncated to the first 12 of 113 rows, and the earlier traces_search_by_tags call failed with RESULT_TOO_LARGE, so the full failing-span population was not read.

The propagated message wording 'failed POST to email service: expected 200, got 500' names an email service although no email span or shipping-to-email call was observed; whether this is a mislabeled hard-coded string could not be confirmed.

email, payment and quote had 0 span rate at 06:40Z, so for email and payment this is absent traffic rather than verified health; no conclusion about their behaviour under load is possible from this window.
Whether any end-user-visible business impact beyond the observed HTTP 500s on the load-generator's checkout calls occurred was not measured.

No latency baseline comparison was performed for the frontend/checkout path; the failures are fast (shipping server span about 60-70us, checkout PlaceOrder about 8ms) rather than timeouts, but no latency trend was assessed.
The structured frontend operation breakdown was taken at a single instant (06:40Z); per-operation error attribution at other points in the window is unknown.
next_steps: Correct the shipping Deployment env QUOTE_ADDR to 'http://quote:8080' and roll the deployment, then verify shipping /get-quote returns 200 and quote traffic resumes.
Review the change process that produced QUOTE_ADDR='quote:0000' for shipping (config source, template or pipeline substitution) and add pre-rollout validation of service addresses.
Consider a startup self-check or alert on shipping /get-quote error rate, which was 100% failing with zero successful spans in the window, so a config-only rollout failure is caught earlier.
Verify in the alerting configuration why RequestErrorRate rules are not visible in this Prometheus target, and confirm the alert clears once shipping's quote address is fixed.
